name: ai-bench
description: Anatolii's agentic-AI workbench: subagents, skills and tool configs, including skills vendored from other repos with a pinned commit.

interface.shortDescription: Task routing, code review, and plain writing
interface.longDescription: Check incoming tasks against current evidence, route work through focused investigation and change playbooks, review code structure and maintainability, and edit drafts to remove formulaic AI wording. Task intake works with local text or a configured issue tracker.
defaultPrompt: Use task-intake to check this ticket and choose its playbook.
Use task-work to carry this evidence-backed task through its selected playbook.
Use thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review to review this branch's changes.
Use unslop to edit this draft.
